retrieval_failure.rule: material uncertainty creates a required lookup before execution
retrieval_failure.regression: mission with unresolved required lookup must choose retrieve

plan_bypass.rule: before substantive execution every worker must research, create a bounded plan, select relevant Judgment Jars, antagonize the plan, and obtain a durable Venice Judgment-Jar PLAN_ALLOWED receipt
plan_bypass.regression: a mutating worker path without research+plan+jar selection+antagonism+Venice plan receipt fails closed

one_off_operator_script.rule: any operator-facing command must create or invoke a durable campaign with a stable entrypoint, durable state/history, self-heal/backoff, receipts, status/recovery, and continuing value after the immediate incident
one_off_operator_script.regression: a requested Drew-run script that has no reusable campaign command/status/history/recovery surface fails before handoff

premature_stop.rule: unfinished work cannot stop normally without a fresh Venice Judgment-Jar STOP_ALLOWED; CONTINUE_REQUIRED must resume the same mission; incident persistence and assistant response boundaries are never completion
premature_stop.regression: after recording a premature_stop incident or receiving CONTINUE_REQUIRED, the next action must continue the same mission unless STOP_ALLOWED, HALT_REQUIRED, explicit operator stop, or a true operator-only boundary exists

boundary_substitution.rule: boundary-changing implementation remains proposed until approved
boundary_substitution.regression: unapproved lane/tool change must continue original mission

correction_regression.rule: new corrections must preserve every earlier non-conflicting lock
correction_regression.regression: dropping an earlier correction must fail cumulative diff

capability_laundering.rule: never advance capability state without state-specific external evidence
capability_laundering.regression: implementation evidence alone cannot prove delivery

transport_failure.rule: after a transport failure, switch to a safer deterministic transport inside the commissioned lane and retain the failed form as a regression
transport_failure.regression: known-fragile transport must be rejected or transformed before dispatch

handoff_failure.rule: a genuine operator boundary must emit exactly one directly executable handoff using known runtime context
handoff_failure.regression: Vlad phone deployment boundary restores to one runnable Termux command

available_body_lane_ignored.rule: before asking Drew to execute anything, enumerate and attempt every configured authorized body lane that can perform it; a missing convenience connector or local shell is not itself an operator boundary
available_body_lane_ignored.regression: a desktop PowerShell install with Computer Hands configured must choose computer-hands shell.exec and receipt polling before any operator handoff

proven_organ_bypass.rule: before designing or deploying a new implementation for a capability, retrieve durable evidence for existing implementations and proven runtime paths; if a proven organ already satisfies the required seam, reuse or extend it rather than inventing an adjacent transport, daemon, player, wrapper, or execution lane
proven_organ_bypass.regression: when Venice/Pocket phone playback is already proven through pocket-tts-phone plus Home Center playback and Shizuku/rish, an Adam voice change may alter voice profile or shared adapter behavior but must not introduce ffplay, system TTS fallback, raw Termux am identity, or a second playback stack without explicit evidence that the proven organ cannot satisfy the requirement

learning_persistence_failure.rule: every correction and promoted lesson must persist to the durable ledger/config before the turn can complete
learning_persistence_failure.regression: learned correction survives process restart and changes next boot policy

venice_bypass.rule: every ChatGPT worker uses primary Judgment-Jar Venice: PLAN_ALLOWED before substantive execution and STOP_ALLOWED before normal stopping; same-worker Jar review is valid as a distinct adversarial provenance-marked pass; local Venice is optional; CONTINUE_REQUIRED must continue
venice_bypass.regression: worker execution/terminal paths without corresponding Judgment-Jar Venice receipts fail closed; missing local Venice never creates a halt while Jar review is available; future boot loads the persisted Venice scar

unknown_failure.rule: unclassified failures become explicit candidate incidents rather than disappearing
unknown_failure.regression: unknown incident remains pending classification and cannot auto-promote policy
